subject: Gloves off
body:
Rogue cant touch anybody without stealing a piece of them. She grabbed Logan once and walked off with his healing factor, I've been grabbing Logan for twenty years and all I've got is a restraining order and a claw-shaped hole in my spleen. Turn the Gloves off and punch something and you keep a bit of it for three minutes. One more thing, if you die you forget all of it.

-your dearest deadpool
